svg.title: Figure 4 | Branch from a shared upload state
svg.desc: Redrawn from the Balsamiq upload example. The first panel repeats paths; the second shares the uploading state and branches. Failure uses text and a dashed branch, so color is not the only cue.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Figure 4 | Branch from a shared upload state
Redrawn from the Balsamiq upload example. The first panel repeats paths;
the second shares the uploading state and branches. Failure uses text
and a dashed branch, so color is not the only cue.
User uploads file → File is uploading → File successfully uploads
User uploads file → File is uploading → File upload fails
User uploads file → File is uploading
